title: [Peek] The selection in Table of Contents doesn't work when viewing a pdf file
author: NEKolev
summary: Selecting a PDF table-of-contents entry in Peek closes the table of contents instead of navigating to the selected page.
next_action: Reproduce on current stable with a public multi-section PDF and separate panel dismissal from failed page navigation.

confidence.rationale: The labeled reproduction is simple, though no sample document or current-version retest is available.

judgment.rationale: The issue is labeled reproducible and gives a minimal PDF interaction, but contains no discussion or current WebView2 behavior check.
evidence: The reporter opens a PDF, clicks a page or table-of-contents section, and expects page navigation.
The actual result is that the table-of-contents panel closes.
The issue carries the Status-Reproducible label.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce on current stable with a public multi-section PDF and separate panel dismissal from failed page navigation.

fix_assessment.rationale: Current PDF viewer behavior and the exact event path must be verified before selecting a fix.

issue_context.summary: Selecting a PDF table-of-contents entry in Peek closes the table of contents instead of navigating to the selected page.

actions.label: Reproduce PDF table-of-contents navigation
actions.note: Maintainer-side verification only; this artifact performs no upstream write.

reproduce.title: Select outline destinations in Peek's PDF viewer
prerequisites: A public PDF with at least three bookmarked sections and multiple pages
setup: Open File Explorer and select the PDF.
Invoke Peek and open the PDF table-of-contents panel.
steps: Click a destination for a page other than the current page.
Record whether the document navigates before or after the panel closes.
Repeat with keyboard activation of the same destination.
Repeat after reopening Peek to exclude stale viewer state.
reproduce.expected_result: The selected outline entry navigates to its destination; panel dismissal must not replace or cancel navigation.
